NAURA.why: China's largest broad-line wafer fab equipment maker: its CCP etch for advanced-memory high-aspect-ratio etch is in stable volume supply at leading domestic memory makers and its tube ALD ships in volume to domestic memory makers, so NAND capex drives its orders
NAURA.evidence: NAURA 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026): CCP etch 'in stable volume supply at leading domestic memory and logic makers'; 'new-generation tube ALD delivered in volume to domestic memory makers'

players.product: etch (ICP / CCP), PVD / CVD / ALD / epitaxy deposition, vertical-furnace thermal, wet clean and ion implant tools for 3D NAND, DRAM and logic fabs

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 revenue RMB 20.16 billion, up 24.90% YoY, as market share of its etch, deposition, thermal, wet clean, ion implant, coating / developing and bonding tools rose; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 3.37 billion (+5.05%). Gross margin fell from 42.17% to 40.07% because of component iteration costs on new products under customer verification and commercial discounts given to some high-volume customers; expensed R&D RMB 2.677 billion (+28.87%).
quarterly_data.figure: revenue RMB 20.16 billion (+24.90% YoY); net profit RMB 3.37 billion (+5.05%); gross margin 40.07% (42.17% a year earlier)

quarterly_data.signal: Etch: NAURA released a new-generation 12-inch high-end ICP etch tool with angstrom-level uniformity and aspect ratios of several hundred to one for advanced logic and high-end memory; it has completed customer verification and entered volume-production introduction. Its CCP etch is qualified for advanced-memory high-aspect-ratio etch and advanced-logic damascene and is in stable volume supply at leading domestic memory and logic makers.

Deposition and thermal: cumulative 12-inch PVD deliveries passed the thousand-unit mark, as did vertical furnaces; etch, PVD and vertical furnace together have delivered several thousand units cumulatively. The new-generation tube ALD tool was delivered in volume to domestic memory makers and performs well on high-aspect-ratio structures; reduced-pressure epitaxy orders and deliveries kept growing.

Bonding and other tools: NAURA launched 12-inch wafer-to-wafer and die-to-wafer hybrid bonding tools (for HBM, high-end chiplets and image sensors); the die-to-wafer tool is in industrial application, has completed customer verification and won volume orders. Ion implant, plating and coating / developing tools reached scale supply, and high-end TSV plating tools are in scale supply.

Management: generative AI keeps expanding compute infrastructure, lifting demand for advanced logic and high-bandwidth memory chips; memory prices kept rising and chipmakers' willingness to spend on capex is recovering; process shrinks, advanced packaging and 3D stacking raise equipment value per wafer; NAURA's production and delivery remain full.

Precision components: NAURA's high power-density power modules and high-precision analog chips entered the data-center supply chain; high power-density point-of-load power supplies for AI and data-center use are shipping in growing volume.
